current.text: Miami acquired him in the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade. He is a backup big behind Bam Adebayo and Giannis.
He is part of Miami's main nine-man rotation, with Larsson, Fontecchio and Jovic off the bench.
He shot 46% from three last season after 37% the year before.
Expect his three-point shooting to fall back to about 39%, in about 21 minutes per game. His fantasy value comes only from rebounds and scoring.
Miami's big man depth is weak. Be careful with Miami players on the margins.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs. It plays only 10 games in the playoff weeks.

durable.text: He rarely blocks shots. His block conversion is 4.8%, against a league average of 13%.
His FT% drop to 71% last season had no clear cause. As a good shooter, he should shoot free throws better than that.
For a big, he adds threes and rebounds with few turnovers. His blocks are weak for his position.
